title: A Small Immunity Gap Can Restart Measles At 95% Protection
hook: Measles needs 95% protection. Kindergartens are already below it.
closing: A small protection gap can reopen outbreaks, so every vaccine helps shield your town.
question: Did you get both measles shots?

segments.say: One measles case infects about fifteen people. The virus races through a crowd the moment protection slips.
Measles is stopped when ninety-five percent of kids are protected. Kindergartners fall just short, and the virus finds every gap.
US measles cases grew about nine times recently. A small protection gap let each outbreak snowball.
